name: Dust of Death
body:
School transmutation; Level sorcerer/wizard 6

CASTING

Casting Time 1 round
Components V, S, M (a pinch of sand and crushed hemlock)

EFFECT

Range touch
Area a few ounces of sand
Duration 1 hour
Saving Throw Fort negates (see text); Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

This spell transforms a few ounces of normal sand into a deadly poison for the duration. If the sand is then consumed (say because it was placed in a foe’s drink or sprinkled on its food), the imbiber must succeed on a Fortitude save or be affected by the poison (see below).

Dust of Death: type ingested; Fort DC 10 + spell level + caster’s key ability; onset 1 minute; frequency 1/minute for 6 minutes; effect 1d4 Con damage; cure 1 save.
